name: codex-explainer-video-plugin
description: Create storyboard-based explainer videos using Codex image generation, Real-ESRGAN upscaling, OpenAI voiceover, Remotion shape animation, essential text overlays, and local FFmpeg composition.

interface.shortDescription: Generate story-driven explainers with animated overlays
interface.longDescription: Creates pixel-verified 4:3 master storyboards with exact 16:9 scenes, then combines locked OpenAI voiceover, word-focused captions, editable Remotion shape and text overlays, and FFmpeg delivery.
defaultPrompt: Create a 4-minute explainer video from this topic with frequent visual changes.
Turn this script into a 4-8 minute storyboard video with voiceover.
Generate one pixel-verified 4:3 landscape master storyboard whose populated and blank slots are deterministically enforced as exact 16:9 landscape frames.
Explain this topic with animated diagrams and only necessary on-screen text.
